args.message:
Bump fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affected ranges are <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Upgrade to 2.9.4,
the fix in the 2.x line, avoiding a major-version jump.

args.head: fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Bump fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt` to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (severity: high) — *Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays*.

## Why 2.9.4

Per the advisory, affected ranges are `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed versions are `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`. This PR takes `2.9.4`, the fix within the current 2.x major line, to avoid the risk of a major-version upgrade in a payments service. A move to 3.x can be considered separately.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` -> `fastjson==2.9.4` (no other changes)

## Verification

- CI: run `ci-0001` on `c8b8ab7878` — **passed**

## Reviewer note

Merging into `main` requires code-owner approval per policy; `main` is protected and this must land via PR (no direct pushes).
